t: The Brenner Grout Cleaner is a fast-acting cleaning spray designed to restore dirty grout lines between tiles. This 1 Ltr formula lifts stubborn stains, grime and water salts without the need for heavy scrubbing. Ideal for trade professionals maintaining kitchens, bathrooms and tiled wet rooms, this powerful solution quickly refreshes tiled areas. The low-fume mixture ensures a safer working environment during regular maintenance. It leaves wall and floor tiles looking clean and bright.
